capabilities: Schedule recurring tasks with inline :: ... :: tags
Roll uncompleted tasks over to the next day
Snooze tasks or set multi-day task periods
Auto-check parent tasks and show subtask progress counters
Gather tasks in tracker notes marked with a property
extras: README is informal and profanity-laden. Schedule tooltips only work for tasks inside the configured Daily Notes or Periodic Notes folder, the plugin is not supported in reading view, and mobile is untested. Forks must credit the author.
intentEvidence: it basically replaces that uh goaltodo plugin which is really cool
motivation: The author made the plugin for their own needs and then decided to let other people use it.
problem: Daily notes have no built-in way to repeat a task on a schedule or carry unfinished tasks forward to the next day.
